notes.text: Section, act May 21, 1872, ch. 178, 17 Stat. 137, related to offense and punishment of claim agent, attorney or other person for withholding military land bounty warrant. See section 290 of Title 18, Crimes and Criminal Procedure.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal effective Sept. 1, 1948, see section 20 of act June 25, 1948.
